basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost per part at its Braga plant and put the improvements in place?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost per part baseline at the Braga plant and size the improvement opportunities.

gate.label: Initiative go/no-go
gate.decision: Go or no-go on implementing the sized initiatives at the plant?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Put the approved initiatives in place at the plant in waves and track results against the baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final results and confirm the improvements are running at the plant?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; 16-20 weeks is an estimate resting on the archetype's typical weeks and time for savings to show.
No Measurement phase: the archetype tracks results inside Implementation; confirm whether the client wants a separate post-launch measurement period.
